full_prompt_en: A square monochrome mezzotint-like print shows a bare old tree reaching across a narrow pale path in a dark woodland. The heavy trunk is rooted at the right edge, mostly cropped from sight, while its branches sweep left through the middle and upper half. Many thin twigs overlap in delicate, tangled lines against a softly glowing gray sky. The left side of the forest sinks almost to black, with only faint branches emerging from the deep tone. At the bottom, the path begins as a broad light patch and bends toward the right center, where it vanishes under the tree. Uneven pale marks along it suggest snow, dust, or light on rough ground, but the surface remains deliberately indistinct. Dark root-like shadows cut across this brightness, echoing the branches overhead. Beyond the large tree, upright trunks dissolve into silvery fog, giving depth to an otherwise compressed, shadowy setting. The tree's near branches are more sharply drawn, while the distant ones fade into the velvety tonal field. The print has a densely grained surface rather than clean black-and-white outlines; light seems scraped or burnished out of darkness in the sky and across the path. The viewpoint is low and still, placing the viewer just before the bend beneath the extending limbs. Illumination filters from the cloudy opening above and slightly to the left, touching the path in broken patches while leaving the surrounding understory in heavy shade. No figure or readable text appears. The overall composition is hushed and ominous, using the pale winding ground and intricate branch web to make a route through deep, soft blackness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近似铜版摇点法的单色版画里，一棵光秃老树越过深色林地中的浅色窄路。粗重树干扎根于右边缘，大部分被画框裁去；枝条则扫向左侧，穿过中部和上半幅。许多细小枝梢在柔和发亮的灰天前交叠成纤巧缠绕的线。林地左边几乎沉为黑色，只有隐约枝条从深调里浮出。底部的小路以大片亮色开始，向右侧中央弯去，在树下消失。路面上不均匀的浅痕让人想到雪、尘土或粗糙地面的光，但表面有意保持含糊。深色根状阴影横切亮路，呼应头顶枝条。大树后方的直立树干融入银灰雾气，为本来压缩的阴暗场景提供纵深。近处树枝画得较锐利，远处树枝则渐渐散入天鹅绒般的明暗场。版面具有密实颗粒表面，而非干净黑白轮廓；天空与路面的光似乎是从黑暗里刮出或磨亮的。视点低而静，观者停在伸展枝条下、弯道之前。照明从上方略偏左的阴云开口过滤下来，以破碎亮斑触及小路，周围林下却留在厚重暗影中。没有人物或可读文字。整体构图安静而不祥，以浅色蜿蜒地面和精细枝网，在柔软深黑中辟出一条路。
style_prompt_en: The image has a velvet-black mezzotint print surface in which light is lifted gradually from dense grain. Broad shadow areas retain fine mottling, and pale passages bloom softly rather than meeting darkness at a hard contour. Delicate branching lines thread through the middle values, becoming increasingly faint with distance. Charcoal, silver gray, smoky white, and near black supply the entire tonal range. One winding bright shape opens the lower frame and recedes into a heavy dark field, giving the space a quiet depth. Diffuse overhead light touches selected surfaces while surrounding recesses remain almost opaque. The texture is granular and rubbed, with highlights seeming burnished out of the dark plate. The overall effect is atmospheric, intimate, and slightly foreboding, balancing intricate line networks with large calm masses of shade.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有天鹅绒般深黑的铜版摇点质感，光从密实颗粒中逐渐被提亮。大片阴影仍保留细微斑点，浅色区域柔软绽开，而不是以硬轮廓撞上黑暗。纤巧分枝线穿过中间调，随距离增加而渐淡。炭黑、银灰、烟白与近黑构成全部明度范围。一道蜿蜒的亮形打开下方画面，并退入厚重深色域，赋予空间安静纵深。上方散射光触及选定表面，周围凹处依旧近乎不透明。纹理带颗粒和磨擦感，高光仿佛从深色版面磨亮而来。整体效果富大气、亲密且略带不祥，以精细线网平衡大块平静阴影。
theme_en: A bare branching tree over a pale path in a dark mezzotint woodland
theme_zh: 深色铜版摇点风林地中，一棵光秃枝树伸过浅色小路
name: Mezzotint print
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
